name: Schriever SFB
description: Schriever SFB east of Colorado Springs hosts multiple Space Force mission deltas and, since June 2025, Space Base Delta 41 as the dedicated host organization for installation and combat-support functions. A no-flightline, mission-focused base; many quality-of-life services remain coordinated with the broader Colorado Springs Space Force community.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. All visitors must obtain a base pass through the Visitor Control Center — Trusted Traveler Program suspended.

gates.name: North Enoch Gate (Main Gate)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate on Enoch Road. Visitor Control Center is located here just prior to the gate entry. Can issue visitor passes when VCC is closed.

gates.name: West Irwin Gate
gates.notes: Closest gate to Colorado Springs via HWY 94 and Irwin Road. Closed weekends, federal holidays, and base down days.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (North Enoch Gate)
gates.notes: Closed weekends, federal holidays, and base down days. Pre-register visitors via DBIDS/DVES. REAL ID required. RA badges issued Mon-Fri 0700-1200 — call 719-567-5620 to confirm walk-ins.

resources.name: Satellite Dish Dining Facility
resources.description: Cafeteria-style dining in the Restricted Area — not a traditional open DFAC. Active duty and DoD civilians Mon-Fri breakfast and lunch only; all Schriever employees for dinner, midnight meal, and all meals on weekends and federal holidays. Ala-carte pricing with hot line, snack line, deli, salad bar, and specialty bar.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Breakfast 0600-0800, Lunch 1030-1300, Dinner 1600-1830, Midnight 2300-0100; Sat-Sun/Holidays: Breakfast 0630-0800, Lunch 1100-1300, Dinner 1600-1830
resources.address: Bldg 300, Schriever SFB, CO 80912

resources.name: AAFES Food Trucks
resources.description: Rotating AAFES food trucks near the dining facility. No traditional DFAC or full-service restaurants elsewhere on base — most off-base dining is in Colorado Springs or Falcon.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 1030-1300 (schedule posted when available; subject to change)
resources.address: Schriever SFB, Colorado Springs, CO 80912

resources.name: Peterson SFB Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Schriever has no on-base BX. Peterson SFB Exchange (~10 miles west) is the primary exchange for Schriever personnel — clothing, electronics, food court, barber, and optical.
resources.address: 1030 E Stewart Ave, Peterson SFB, CO 80914

resources.name: Peterson SFB Commissary
resources.description: Schriever has no on-base commissary. Peterson SFB Commissary is the nearest DECA grocery for Schriever families and personnel.
resources.address: 1040 E Stewart Ave, Peterson SFB, CO 80914

resources.name: Schriever Clinic (21st Medical Group)
resources.description: Limited ambulatory clinic on Schriever for routine appointments. Full MTF services, specialty care, and emergency department are at Peterson SFB or through the Colorado Springs TRICARE network.
resources.address: 220 Falcon Pkwy, Bldg 220, Schriever SFB, CO 80912

resources.name: 21st Medical Group (Peterson SFB)
resources.description: Primary MTF for Schriever personnel — family medicine, pediatrics, flight medicine, behavioral health, women's health, lab, and immunizations. No emergency department on base; use 911 or local hospitals.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; Wed morning closed for training
resources.address: 559 Vincent St, Bldg 959, Peterson SFB, CO 80914

resources.name: Schriever Clinic Pharmacy
resources.description: Outpatient pharmacy at the Schriever clinic. Peterson MTF pharmacy available for expanded services and refills.
resources.address: 220 Falcon Pkwy, Bldg 220, Schriever SFB, CO 80912

resources.name: Schriever Fitness Center
resources.description: Weight room, cardio theater, indoor track, basketball gym, group exercise, and personal trainers. Outdoor training pad with free weights, kettlebells, pull-up stations, rower, and assault bike open 24/7. Fitness On Demand kiosk for 24/7 instructor-led classes.
resources.address: 120 Voyager Rd, Bldg 120, Schriever SFB, CO 80912

resources.name: 50th Comptroller Squadron (Finance)
resources.description: Military pay, travel vouchers, and finance customer service. Submit inquiries through the Air Force Comptroller Services Portal for fastest response.
resources.address: 210 Falcon Pkwy, Bldg 210, Schriever SFB, CO 80912

resources.name: Military Personnel Flight (MPF)
resources.description: ID cards, DEERS, assignments, promotions, and personnel actions for all Air Force, Space Force, and tenant units. Appointment-based via RAPIDS for new CACs.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0800-1500; CAC walk-in Mon-Fri 0800-1100 for unblocks and certification issues
resources.address: 210 Falcon Pkwy, Bldg 210 Rm 137, Schriever SFB, CO 80912

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation, deployment support, financial readiness, newcomers briefing (Right Start), employment assistance, EFMP, Key Spouse, and Air Force Aid Society referrals.
resources.address: 101 Falcon Pkwy, Schriever SFB, CO 80912

resources.name: 50th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: All MWR programs — dining, fitness, recreation, child care, and community events. Primary garrison support for this satellite ops base.
resources.hours: Facility hours listed on FSS website
resources.address: Schriever SFB, Colorado Springs, CO 80912

resources.name: Military Housing Office
resources.description: Off-base housing referrals and lease review. Schriever has privatized on-post family housing via Tierra Vista Communities; most personnel live in Colorado Springs, Falcon, or Peyton. Visit MHO before signing any lease.
resources.address: 300 Hartinger Circle, Schriever SFB, CO 80930

resources.name: Tierra Vista Communities (On-Base Housing)
resources.description: Privatized family housing community at Schriever SFB managed by Tierra Vista Communities.
resources.address: 300 Hartinger Circle, Colorado Springs, CO 80930

resources.name: Pikes Peak Lodge (Peterson SFB)
resources.description: TDY and PCS temporary lodging at nearby Peterson SFB — shared TLF for Schriever arrivals. Book early during PCS season; off-base hotels also available in Colorado Springs.
resources.hours: Lodging desk open 24 hours daily; Check-in 1400, Check-out 1100
resources.address: 125 E Stewart Ave, Bldg 1042, Peterson SFB, CO 80914

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation & ITT
resources.description: Equipment rentals (bikes, camping gear, bouncy castles), RV/trailer storage, archery range, and RecON adventure trips for active duty and dependents.
resources.address: 805 Skylab Rd, Bldg 805, Schriever SFB, CO 80912

resources.name: Information, Tickets & Travel
resources.description: Discounted theme park, ski lift, and event tickets. Colorado Springs and Denver-area recreation opportunities.
resources.address: 300 Hartinger Circle, Bldg 300, Schriever SFB, CO 80912

resources.name: Child Development Center
resources.description: Full-day child care for eligible military and DoD families. Waitlists common — register early through MilitaryChildCare.com.
resources.address: 60 Hahn Ave, Bldg 60, Schriever SFB, CO 80912

resources.name: Visitor Control Center
resources.description: Visitor passes and base access at the North Enoch Gate. All visitors require a pass — Trusted Traveler suspended. Pre-register via DBIDS/DVES.
resources.address: 1560 Enoch Rd, Colorado Springs, CO 80930

resources.name: 50th Security Forces Squadron
resources.description: Base defense, law enforcement, and gate operations. Emergency dispatch through the unified Emergency Communications Center.
resources.address: Schriever SFB, Colorado Springs, CO 80912

resources.name: School Liaison Office
resources.description: K-12 school information for El Paso County districts — Falcon School District 49, Colorado Springs D11, and surrounding areas.
resources.address: 210 Falcon Pkwy, Bldg 210, Schriever SFB, CO 80912

resources.name: Force Development & Education Center
resources.description: Tuition assistance, CCAF, testing services, and professional military education counseling.
resources.address: 210 Falcon Pkwy, Bldg 210, Schriever SFB, CO 80912

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to the Military Personnel Flight at Bldg 210 upon arrival. Attend the Right Start newcomers orientation at the M&FRC. Schriever is a satellite ops base — many services are at Peterson SFB (~10 miles west).

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Military Housing Office before arrival. Most personnel live off-base in Colorado Springs, Falcon, or Peyton. On-post privatized housing is available through Tierra Vista Communities. Temporary lodging is at Pikes Peak Lodge on Peterson SFB — book early during PCS season.

sections.title: Gate Access
sections.body: North Enoch Gate is open 24/7. West Irwin Gate is Mon-Fri 0600-1900 (closed weekends and holidays). Visitor Control Center hours are Mon-Thu 0700-1600 and Fri 0700-1400. REAL ID required for all visitors.

sections.title: Satellite Base Limitations
sections.body: Schriever has no on-base BX, commissary, or traditional DFAC. Use Peterson SFB for exchange and commissary shopping. Dining on Schriever is limited to the Satellite Dish cafeteria (restricted area) and AAFES food trucks. Full medical care is at Peterson SFB or through the Colorado Springs TRICARE network.
